messages:
sara kim: FYI team — official midyear review timeline posted. Key dates: self-assessments due by June 15 EOD, manager summaries due June 20, calibration meetings week of June 22. Please skim the guide before starting: <https://redwood-internal/forms/midyear-2026|midyear self-assessment>.
kenji watanabe: thanks! will calendar-block. any recommended length for IC self-assesment?
sara kim: bullets + 2 short examples per major accomplishment works well. Keep it outcome-focused (metrics where possible). There's a short template in the form header.
hr-bot: Quick checklist: - IC complete self-assessment by 2026-06-15 - Manager draft summary by 2026-06-20 - Manager attend 60min calibration slot week of 2026-06-22 - HR publish provisional calibration notes by 2026-06-24
maria gonzalez: where do we capture career goals? separate field?
sara kim: yes — "Growth & Goals" section at the bottom. Add 1-2 stretch projects if you have them.
dave li: is there an export for my directs to track completion?
sara kim: run `hrctl reviews export --team dave --fields name,email,status` to get a CSV.
kenji watanabe: for managers: should we fill summaries before calibration or after gathering skip-levels?
sara kim: fill initial manager summaries before your calibration slot. Skip-level feedback can be appended but try to have the core summary ready.
dave li: heads up — I have one team member on parental leave; should I ask for an extension?
sara kim: yes please flag names to me. We’ll adjust deadlines individually.
hr-bot: Reminder: auto-pings will go out 3 days before the self-assessment deadline to anyone who hasn’t started.
kenji watanabe: great, thanks all.
